content.name: Chloe Brennan-Tui
content.title: Teacher Aide (Primary)
content.summary: Teacher aide at a Brisbane state primary school with a Certificate IV in School Based Education Support and experience in outside school hours care. I support literacy groups and students with disability in Years 1–3, and hold a current blue card and HLTAID011 first aid.

experience.title: OSHC Educator (part-time)
bullets: Supervised up to 45 children aged 5–12 before and after school and in vacation care.
Planned weekly art and science activities that lifted vacation care bookings by 15% over two holidays.
Completed incident and medication records accurately under the National Quality Framework.

experience.title: Teacher Aide
bullets: Run daily small-group reading for 3 groups of 5 Year 1 and 2 students, using decodable readers chosen by the teacher.
Support 2 students with verified disability in a Year 3 class, adjusting tasks in line with their personalised learning plans.
Help prepare resources for 6 classes, saving teachers around 3 hours a week in printing and laminating.
Supervise playground duty and assist with first aid during breaks.

education.degree: Certificate IV in School Based Education Support
